snippet.title: ILA: A Frosty Glide Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Featured in Wholesome Direct and released on Monday, ILA: A Frosty Glide is a game about a spirited young witch searching for her lost kitty. "With your trusty skatebroom, find secret places and collectables, and improve your magic and flying abilities as you reach the summit." https://store.steampowered.com/app/1560160/ILA_A_Frosty_Glide/ #indiegames #gaming #cozygames
